newsitem.title: FRANCE: Louis Harris poll gives French right seat majority.
newsitem.headline: Louis Harris poll gives French right seat majority.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of French voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 parliamentary election.
The telephone poll of 1,003 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by Louis Harris on May 5 for French weekly Valeurs Actuelles and made public on May 7.
NOTE - The figures in brackets give the change in voting intentions since an April 28 Louis Harris poll for Valeurs Actuelle.
* no separate figure given for ecologists, who were included in total for Socialists and other left.
The seat projections cover the 555 constituencies in metropolitan France, not the 22 seats in overseas departments and territories.

Louis Harris said 26 percent of those polled did not say how they would vote. It said the voting intentions were based on responses of those who said they were both registered and would definitely vote.
Thirty percent of those polled said they could still change their minds.
